comparisons.reason: Different constructs. Feature 0 returns 1 if any comment engages in any way (addresses, questions, rebuts, accepts, builds on) a specific OP-cited example or premise. Feature 1 is much narrower. It needs a single comment that explicitly acknowledges a specific OP component as valid and then, after that acknowledgment, presents a counter-example. Feature 1 also excludes quoted text and bot/moderator notices. Feature 0 does not require acknowledgment, ordering, or a counter-example.
